messages:
Aditi: Quick sync — nightly perf sweep flagged a p95 regression for pegasus11b when batch_size > 8. Noticed it in the 00:30 run, p95 up ~40% vs baseline :eyes:. Can folks triage?

samuel: saw the alert, digging. Any recent weight/tokenizer changes for that catalog entry?

Aditi: weights moved yesterday to s3://redwood-models/pegasus11b/v3/weights.tar (sha256: f7d3e8...). Tokenizer files were supposed to travel with it but I only see tokenizer.json, no merges/vocab in the manifest.

luca: I ran a quick local micro-bench. Reproducer: 
```
run_bench --model s3://redwood-models/pegasus11b/v3 --batch 8 --seq 1024 --iters 50
run_bench --model s3://redwood-models/pegasus11b/v3 --batch 16 --seq 1024 --iters 50
```
Batch 8: p95 ~82ms, Batch 16: p95 ~120ms (on same infra). p50 stayed close.

perf-bot: nightly-perf-run/1893456: p95 crossed SLO threshold for pegasus11b (SLO 100ms) — alert created.

chris: can we check runtime config? We recently pushed a change to continuous-batching defaults (max_batch_tokens). If that dropped, larger batch sizes could be splitting differently and causing batch packing churn.

Aditi: good point — eng-runtime deployed a config change yesterday evening (rolled by @infra-rollout). IIRC max_batch_tokens was lowered as part of a CPU-contend mitigation.

samuel: also noticed tokenizer v3 tokenizes stray double-hyphens and some doc strings differently. That increases token count for some prompts by ~5-10% which amplifies batching effects. I'll paste a tiny diff: 
```
- token: "--"
+ token: "- -"  # v3 split into two tokens in tokenizer.json
```
This explains higher per-request tokens in some cases.

luca: running a quick experiment: re-run bench with explicit continuous batching override: 
```
run_bench --model s3://redwood-models/pegasus11b/v3 --batch 16 --seq 1024 --iters 30 --max_batch_tokens 8192 --kv_cache true
```
Starting now, ETA ~3m.

luca: result: p95 back to ~85-90ms with max_batch_tokens=8192 and kv_cache=true. So config looks like main lever.

chris: sounds like two contributing factors: tokenizer change increasing tokens/request and a lower max_batch_tokens producing more frequent small batches & evictions. Combined they hit p95.

Aditi: agreement on mitigation: revert max_batch_tokens to 8192 for pegasus11b canary, and patch tokenizer (restore merges/vocab) in the manifest. Also add a catalog onboarding check that verifies tokenizer files exist and run a quick token-count diff against canonical prompts.

samuel: I can add the tokenizer check and open a PR to add the merges/vocab to the s3 manifest. Will include a small unit test: token_count(ref_prompts) delta < 3%.

chris: I'll coordinate the runtime rollback for the pegasus11b canary and schedule a canary perf run. If canary looks good, we roll to prod.

perf-bot: Created ticket INF-4721: "pegasus11b p95 regression — tokenizer + batching - canary rollback + onboarding checks" assigned to samuel, chris.

Aditi: Thanks. Planned next steps: 1) samuel PR for tokenizer files + tests, 2) chris rollback for canary + run perf, 3) luca validate bench numbers and paste artifacts in the ticket. I'll monitor nightly after changes.

luca: will attach bench artifacts (latency histograms + run configs) to INF-4721 in ~10m.

samuel: opening PR now, pinging @eng-runtime for the rollback.

Aditi: perfect — keep updates in the ticket. Good catch everyone :thumbsup:
